$comment: The topic overlay (#199: topic is a subject type on any owning scope): what a research or topic brain accumulates about one subject — the works it reads, the claims drawn from them, the syntheses written across claims, the reading sessions that produced them and the threads still open. Composes as core + documents + topic with no delivery IA; it refines contextRecipes.default, so it does not compose with engagement. Kinds are declared, not yet compiled (node null): records live in their fill-in artifacts or markdown storage until a source adapter compiles them.

kinds.title: Research Source
kinds.description: A work the topic draws on (paper, article, book, dataset, talk, interview), with its citation and revision. The brain holds the reference and notes, not a copy of the work.

kinds.title: Claim
kinds.description: A single assertion attributed to one or more research sources, with the locator that supports it. Disagreement between claims is a contradicts edge, not an edit.

kinds.title: Synthesis
kinds.description: Authored current understanding of the topic or one question within it, built from claims. Revised as claims arrive; a change of position supersedes the prior synthesis.

kinds.title: Reading Session
kinds.description: A bounded stretch of reading or review: which research sources were read, when, and the claims and threads it produced. Append-only.

kinds.title: Open Thread
kinds.description: A line of inquiry still being pursued: what to read or test next and why. Closes into a synthesis or is dropped with a reason.

edges.description: A claim or synthesis cites a research source as its evidence.
A research source was read in a reading session.
An open thread follows up a claim, synthesis or research source.

contextRecipes.$comment: Topic task pack (#205): from any node, the documents it references, the research sources it cites, the claims that support it, the claims it contradicts, the threads still open against it and the sessions a source was read in. Replaces core's identity-only default; scripts/gen-task-pack.py walks each hop from the task node.
